{{Quote|Jabba's picky about salads. He will eat squill liver salad though.|[[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]]|<ref name="SWG:JPP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Porcellus|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Squill liver salad''' was a [[Salad/Legends|salad]] made of [[Liver/Legends|livers]] of [[Squill (creature)|squills]]. When [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] made squill liver salad for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], he preferred livers from mountain squills, as he considered livers from desert squills to be too rubbery. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Porcellus sent a spacer to the area known as [[Squill Sanctuary]] to kill several mountain squills and bring him their livers to cook this salad for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="SWG:JPP" />
